messages:
maya: Hey team — quick perf favor: need benchmarking for quasar-7b-v2 (new weights). Please test variants fp16, q4_0, and int8-qat. We need p50/p95 for 1-token and 1k-token contexts, throughput for batch sizes 1/8/32, and GPU memory. Also check KV-cache warm vs cold. Target infra: h100-dedicated and a100-hosted. Paste the bench commands you ran and upload JSON outputs to s3. If results look good, we'll promote a default variant in the model catalog.

evan: On it. I'll run h100 first then a100 for comparison. Enqueuing now. ETA ~2h. @perf-bot please enqueue this job.

perf-bot: Job queued: id=qb7v2-1765009999. Allocated: h100-dedicated-2, a100-shared-2. ETA ~80m.

jia: I'll take int8-qat traces and look for memory fragmentation and long-tail spikes. Will report if p95 regresses.

ops-bot: Heads up: h100-dedicated maintenance 18:00 UTC today — avoid long jobs past 17:30 UTC.

evan: Ran fp16 + q4_0 on h100 (seq=512). Commands used:
```bash
redwood-bench run --model quasar-7b-v2 --variant fp16 --device h100-dedicated-2 --dataset lm-smoke-100 --batch-sizes 1,8,32 --seq-len 512 --out /tmp/qb7_fp16_h100_seq512.json
redwood-bench run --model quasar-7b-v2 --variant q4_0 --device h100-dedicated-2 --dataset lm-smoke-100 --batch-sizes 1,8,32 --seq-len 512 --out /tmp/qb7_q4_h100_seq512.json
```
Summary (h100, seq512):
- fp16:
  - b=1: p50=23ms p95=68ms mem=15.0GB throughput=110 tok/s
  - b=8: p50=48ms p95=115ms mem=16.5GB throughput=760 tok/s
  - b=32: p50=180ms p95=320ms mem=19.5GB throughput=2380 tok/s
- q4_0:
  - b=1: p50=15ms p95=42ms mem=7.3GB throughput=165 tok/s
  - b=8: p50=38ms p95=98ms mem=9.4GB throughput=970 tok/s
  - b=32: p50=155ms p95=270ms mem=11.2GB throughput=2850 tok/s
Notes: q4_0 shows ~50% memory reduction and better p50s. p95 still has some variability (scheduler/batching tail).

jia: int8-qat quick pass on a100 (seq512):
- b=1: p50=17ms p95=52ms mem=6.9GB throughput=148 tok/s
- b=8: p50=42ms p95=110ms mem=8.8GB throughput=890 tok/s
Note: a100-shared showed occasional p95 spikes when other tenants ramped.

evan: Long-context (seq=1024) runs on h100, batch=1. Commands:
```bash
redwood-bench run --model quasar-7b-v2 --variant fp16 --device h100-dedicated-2 --dataset lm-smoke-100 --batch-sizes 1 --seq-len 1024 --out /tmp/qb7_fp16_h100_seq1k.json
redwood-bench run --model quasar-7b-v2 --variant q4_0 --device h100-dedicated-2 --dataset lm-smoke-100 --batch-sizes 1 --seq-len 1024 --out /tmp/qb7_q4_h100_seq1k.json
```
seq1k results (b=1):
- fp16: p50=48ms p95=170ms mem=18.9GB tok/s=92
- q4_0: p50=32ms p95=125ms mem=11.6GB tok/s=138
Observation: fp16 p95 widened on some runs due to occasional cuda alloc/kv growth latency; q4_0 stayed more stable.

evan: Compared to baseline (quasar-7b-v1 fp16): no p50 regressions for q4_0 or int8-qat. Overall cost/perf favors q4_0 as the catalog default; int8-qat is a good fallback for tight-memory infra. Recommend calling out p95 caveats on shared a100 hosts.

maya: Thanks — can someone open a PR to model-catalog and upload the JSON outputs and commands? Add a short rollout note recommending q4_0 as default and caveat about p95 on mixed-tenant a100.

thomas: I'll take the PR. Will add notes about scheduling and the h100 maintenance window; recommend pinning Dedicated for latency-sensitive customers.

evan: Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-inference/qb7v2/1765009999/ and draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/413 (includes metrics, commands, and perf graphs).

maya: Perfect. If nothing else pops up, let's promote q4_0 as preferred in the catalog and add rollout guidance for Dedicated customers. :tada:

jia: Quick follow-up: I'll run a 24h int8-qat stability trace overnight and post anomalies here tomorrow morning.

perf-bot: Job completed: qb7v2-1765009999. Logs and outputs uploaded to s3.

maya: Closing the loop — awesome work, team. :heart:
